gradient_rule.statistic: per-layer, per-token-type EMA of pre-FFN activation-gradient L2 norm
gradient_rule.timing: strictly one-step lagged; no current-step gradient or dense pre-pass
gradient_rule.initialization: exact-budget random on the first step; unseen token types thereafter use the observed layer mean

shuffled_control: permute valid low-max-abs scores within each sequence and layer; preserve score distribution, exact active count, execution path, and budget
reused_references: uniform low_max_abs, random, dense, and dense-fewer from results-program/dev-long with identical body and online seeds
primary_endpoints: each gradient sign minus uniform low_max_abs sparse loss at steps 50, 100, 150, and 200
each gradient sign minus random and shuffled low_max_abs sparse loss
low_max_abs minus shuffled low_max_abs as the assignment diagnostic
dense-fewer comparison at matched total cost including auxiliary operations
dense evaluation, realized activity, gradient-state coverage, and zero extra gradient forward passes

decision_rules.gradient_beats_program: one sign must beat uniform low_max_abs, random, and shuffled low_max_abs at step 200 in all four regimes
decision_rules.selection: if both signs qualify, select the smaller mean final loss difference from uniform low_max_abs
decision_rules.fresh_confirmation: a qualifying gradient sign earns unchanged fresh-to-gradient replication on bodies 9 and 10
decision_rules.development_level_3_signal: the selected gradient rule must also beat dense-fewer at matched total cost in all four regimes
decision_rules.keep_program: if neither gradient sign qualifies, stop lagged-gradient development and retain the frozen low_max_abs program

prohibited: adding a dense gradient pre-pass or omitting auxiliary costs
treating shuffling as the proposed method rather than a control
claiming Level 3 from wins over random or shuffling alone
tuning beta, sign, initialization, or budget semantics on confirmation bodies
